name: HNS_NOTES
description: HNS NOTES. This table stores all the notes. Notes are primarily CLOB column and stored separately.

columns.name: NOTES_ID
columns.description: NOTES_ID unique identifer. Primary key for table HNS_NOTES.

columns.name: AUTHOR_ID
columns.description: Author identifier for a NOTES. Author  is an employee who add comments to the note.

columns.name: NOTES_CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Notes Create Date column. Date autopopulated once a note is created.

columns.name: NOTES
columns.description: Notes clob column. This column is an append only column.

columns.name: TASK_ID
columns.description: Task Identifier. Task is defined as either incident_id, investigation_id or action_id.

columns.name: UPDATED_BY
columns.description: The person / owner who updated the note. Note is an append only column. It can only be updated.

columns.name: UPDATED_DATE
columns.description: UPDATE_DATE column: The date the note got updated.

columns.name: TASK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of task i.e. Incident, Investigation or Action.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
